title: Jacob's Struggle with God in the Prophecy of Hosea
description: The prophet Hosea reminds Israel of Jacob's life: how he grasped his brother's heel while still in the womb and later wrestled with God and an angel, weeping and pleading for a blessing. In Bethel, God met him, and the Lord, the God of hosts, is His name. Hosea uses Jacob's experience as an appeal to Ephraim to turn back to the Lord and hold fast to love and justice.
